segments.text: "I'm going to fight, so I can keep my promise!"

The main character of this story. A completely average high schooler from a completely average family. He can be a little indecisive and pessimistic at times, but when he has something to protect, he'll fight with everything he's got.
Likes: Gore, Misery Porn, Adult Games
"Who are you gonna target? You'll never win the killing game if you don't know who you're gonna kill ahead of time. Unless...is it me?!"

A young woman known for her mood swings and obsession with all things dark and depressing. She's a big fan of killing game stories and has no fear of death. If she has to die, all she wants is a death that's as dramatic and flamboyant as humanly possible.
"You're really going too far now... This is so embarrassing."

One of a set of twins — Kako is the younger by a few minutes. She's prone to spacing out, but also has a keen mind and a healthy sense of curiosity. Kako is a big fan of mystery stories and wants to be a private investigator when she grows up.
"Like it or not, from this day forward, I'm going to be your commanding officer. You can call me Sirei, or just Sir."

The principal and commanding officer of Last Defense Academy. To put it another way, a weird little robot that orders the members of the Special Defense Unit around. Under his command, Takumi and the others will be working to wipe out the mysterious School Invaders.

His name is an acronym of "System Information Reinforcement Exalted Intelligence." In reality, SIREI is an AI that hosts a digitized copy of the collective will of humanity, developed by the scientists of the Exodus Project.
"You wanna die, bitch?! I don't hit girls or kids or old people, but I'll fuckin' kill you!"

An old-school delinquent who lives to ride and rides to live. Despite his rough-and-ready demeanor, Takemaru's really a nice guy on the inside. Impulsive, straightforward, and honorable to a fault, he's sworn to never use his strength to bully the weak.
"Their insides certainly are a pretty color... And the way their brains splatter everywhere when you crush their skulls... It's like poetry in motion!"

Leader of the Special Defense Unit. A cold, almost heartless beauty, she always says what's on her mind, even if it means offending others. She's just as merciless on the battlefield, where she gets a twisted sense of pleasure from tearing invaders apart.
"Y-Yeah, I'm fine! I'll be okay... I just need a minute to calm down!"

A young woman who knows a lot about machines and what makes them tick. She had a bright, lively personality, but isn't good with stressful situations. When she gets nervous, she gets nauseous, and then...
"Oho... You're wondering why I'd hide my noble visage beneath this mask, aren't you? Know your place, scum! Don't insult your betters by trying to understand their decisions!"

The scion of one of the most wealthy families humanity has ever known. She's proud, overbearing, and acts like she's better than anyone else. She always wears a strange tomato mask, never showing her true face.
Dislikes: Series That Get Canceled Too Soon
"Holy Jumonji Sword... Let us unleash chaos on the battlefield together. By my hand, evil shall be cast down!"

A young samurai who's utterly clueless about the modern world. Has never even heard of multiplication tables, let alone learned them. She has a disturbingly close relationship with her katana, the Holy Jumonji Sword.
"Hmph, boys are soooo rude! I'll break your knee with a Dragon Screw as punishment!"

A young woman who is blowing up on the high school pro wrestling scene. Her courage and boundless energy is a source of inspiration for the entire Special Defense Unit. Whenever she has a problem, she faces it head on. She didn't choose the wrasslin' life — it chose her.
"Sure, a little. But it's what we were sent here to do. It's our mission."

A high schooler who combines a kindhearted nature with dogged determination in battle. She's very passionate about the Special Defense Unit's mission, but also seems to be hiding something. For some reason, Nozomi is identical in appearance to Takumi's childhood friend Karua.
"And friends should help each other out, isn't that right? That's why I've decided to fight, too. I've found something that I want to protect."

Takumi's most trusted ally. Eito cares very deeply for his friends and isn't shy about expressing those feelings, corny as they may sound. He's been weak and sickly since he was little, but his impressive intellect might be just what the team needs to guide them through the war safely.
"Who cares about you guys? We've never even met before, I'm sure as heck not gonna waste time worrying about you!"

A guy who's true to his personal desires (to put it delicately). He's a coward and always looking out for himself. However, there's something so refreshingly honest about his pettiness that it's hard to hate him. Gaku's also good at taking care of other people once he opens his heart to them.
Likes: Kako, His Dear Sister, "Sister Dearest"
Dislikes: Anything That Hurts His Dear Sister
"It's a crime that the word could possibly be used to describe anyone else. It should belong to her, and her alone!"

One of a set of twins — Ima is the elder by a few minutes. He acts like a carefree joker, but underneath that humor is a hint of something darker. A hardcore siscon, he thinks of nothing but protecting his sister. If anything or anyone dares to threaten Kako's safety, Ima will show them no mercy.
"I'm fine with it, too. If anything, dry bread is too good for a human cockroach like me."
A young man who, by his own admission, has absolutely nothing going for him. On a scale of one to ten, his self-esteem's at negative five. He's constantly putting himself down.
"Assassination is an art form, man. An expression of joy, love, all that good stuff. And a little mutual bloodlust elevates it to a whole 'nother level."

A striking young man who’s been in the business since long before the war started. Unlike the rest of his family (who are also assassins, by the way), Yugamu believes that killing should be done with love. He enjoys torture and other immoral forms of pleasure.
"I am Nigou. In addition to keeping this place running, I also serve under the Honorable Sirei when occasion demands it."
Sirei's assistant and second in command. An odd little robot that has a gentle, caring personality, but is also prone to making careless mistakes. He's completely loyal and subservient to Sirei.
"I knew you'd protect me... I knew you'd keep your promise."
A childhood friend of the main character, Takumi Sumino. She has a family-like relationship with Takumi, being more than siblings but less than lovers.

She has a gentle demeanor, but is also surprisingly resilient. She lost her father at a young age, and her mother spends most of her time doing research. In spite of all this, Karua works hard to be the best person she can be. Takumi was separated from her when the strange creatures attacked the complex.
She is taken prisoner after a battle and kept in a cage in the school courtyard.
A strange boy who appears in the school from time to time.
His intangible body is wreathed in flames, giving him a ghostlike appearance.
Nobody knows for sure who—or what—he really is.
He is given the name 'Shion' (シオン) by Sirei.
The Supreme Commander of the Futuran army and dictator of Futurum. At only six years old, she defeated the previous Supreme Commander and became the new leader.
The G'ie Queen who takes over Tsukumo Kako's body and impersonates Oosuzuki Kurara. She kidnaps Kirifuji Nozomi and tries to contact the G'ie mother ship.
The Sponsor is a minor antagonist in The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy-. They are the main antagonist of the Killing Game Route.
They have multiple identities, Kako-G and Eito Aotsuki as well as a third unidentified form.
